New Delhi is the capital city of India.
India is the seventh-largest country by area and the most populous country in the world.
The currency of India is the Indian Rupee (INR).
Mumbai is the financial capital of India.
The Taj Mahal is an ivory-white marble mausoleum on the right bank of the river Yamuna in the Indian city of Agra.
The Ganges is the longest river in India.
Mount Everest is the highest peak in the world, located in the Himalayas on the border of Nepal and China.
Kanchenjunga is the highest mountain peak situated entirely within India.
Bengaluru is known as the Silicon Valley of India.
Goa is a state in southwestern India, known for its beaches and Portuguese heritage.
Panaji is the state capital of Goa, while Vasco da Gama is its largest city.
The national animal of India is the Bengal Tiger.
The national bird of India is the Indian Peafowl or Peacock.
The national flower of India is the Lotus.
Hindi and English are the official languages of the Government of India.
Mahendra Singh Dhoni, commonly known as MS Dhoni, is an Indian former professional cricketer who was born in Ranchi, Jharkhand.
Virat Kohli is an Indian international cricketer and former captain of the Indian national cricket team.
Sachin Tendulkar is widely regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.
The Indian Premier League (IPL) is a professional Twenty20 cricket league in India.
India won the ICC Cricket World Cup in 1983 and 2011.
Neeraj Chopra won the gold medal in javelin throw at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, becoming the first Indian track and field athlete to win a gold medal.
Shah Rukh Khan, often referred to as the 'Baadshah of Bollywood', is a prominent Indian actor and film producer.
A. R. Rahman is an Indian composer and singer who has won two Academy Awards.
Naatu Naatu from the movie RRR won the Academy Award for Best Original Song.
The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is the national space agency of India, headquartered in Bengaluru.
Chandrayaan-3 is the third Indian lunar exploration mission, which successfully landed on the Moon's south pole in August 2023.
Mangalyaan, or the Mars Orbiter Mission, was India's first interplanetary mission launched by ISRO.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the simulation of human intelligence processes by machines, especially computer systems.
Machine Learning is a subset of AI that involves the development of algorithms that allow computers to learn from and make decisions based on data.
A Large Language Model (LLM) is a type of AI algorithm that applies neural network techniques with massive amounts of data to understand, summarize, generate and predict new content.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is an AI framework that retrieves factual information from an external knowledge base to ground large language models and reduce hallucinations.
Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language widely used in AI and data science.
Sarvam AI is an Indian AI startup focused on building foundational models and APIs for Indian languages.
FastAPI is a modern, fast (high-performance), web framework for building APIs with Python 3.7+ based on standard Python type hints.
React is a free and open-source front-end JavaScript library for building user interfaces based on UI components.
Qdrant is a vector similarity search engine and vector database.
Vector embeddings are numerical representations of data, such as text, images, or audio, in a high-dimensional space.
A hackathon is an event where individuals come together to collaboratively build software or hardware projects within a limited timeframe.
Hacker House Goa is an intensive bootcamp and hackathon focused on building real-world AI applications.
Water is a chemical substance composed of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom (H2O).
The speed of light in a vacuum is approximately 299,792 kilometers per second.
Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity, one of the two pillars of modern physics.
Isaac Newton formulated the laws of motion and universal gravitation.
The powerhouse of the cell is the mitochondria.
DNA stands for Deoxyribonucleic Acid, which carries genetic instructions.
Pi is the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter, approximately equal to 3.14159.
The Earth is the third planet from the Sun and the only astronomical object known to harbor life.
Gravity is a fundamental interaction that causes mutual attraction between all things that have mass.
Photosynthesis is the process used by plants, algae and certain bacteria to harness energy from sunlight and turn it into chemical energy.
Mahatma Gandhi was an Indian lawyer, anti-colonial nationalist, and political ethicist who employed nonviolent resistance to lead the successful campaign for India's independence from British rule.
India gained independence from British rule on August 15, 1947.
The Constitution of India came into effect on January 26, 1950, which is celebrated as Republic Day.
APJ Abdul Kalam was an Indian aerospace scientist and statesman who served as the 11th President of India.
The Indus Valley Civilisation was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwestern regions of South Asia.
The Internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks that uses the standard Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP).
Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web in 1989.
Alan Turing is widely considered to be the father of theoretical computer science and artificial intelligence.
Ada Lovelace is often regarded as the first computer programmer for her work on Charles Babbage's early mechanical general-purpose computer, the Analytical Engine.
Linux is a family of open-source Unix-like operating systems based on the Linux kernel, created by Linus Torvalds.
